accuracy.evidence: Checked NC Y2 Measurement choose-and-use units (m/cm, kg/g, °C, litres/ml) against match, absurd, estimate and attribute-sort tasks.

misconceptions.evidence: Checked traps: always-cm for every length; ml for a pool; kg for temperature; grams for a heavy bag.

lab_distinct.evidence: Checked flagunits: object→unit matching across attributes; not flaglenht (how to measure length), flagmass (comparing mass), flagtherm (reading °C), or flagcups.

lab_teaches.evidence: Checked: learner matches pencil→cm, spots pool-ml absurdity, estimates bag→kg, picks °C, catches always-cm myth, sorts capacity units.

predictions.evidence: Checked tempting wrongs on oversized units, mass/temp swaps, always-cm myth, and capacity vs heat.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Checked why() splits too-big length units, mass/temp/capacity confusions, and true-statement distractors.

readability.evidence: Checked ages 6–7 kid lines use short unit words; adult names NC Y2 and common slips within family bars.

no_filler.evidence: Checked every sentence teaches a unit match, an absurd contrast, or a named mix-up.

mobile.evidence: Checked large unit lbtn twins and estimate circles; choice rows stay tappable near 390 px.

accessibility.evidence: Checked every canvas pick has a button twin; live aria-label on the figure; challenge uses aria-live status.

sources: UK NC 2013 Maths Y2 Measurement — choose and use appropriate standard units (m/cm, kg/g, °C, litres/ml)
CCSS 2.MD.A related measurement unit sense for length (cross-check only)
